record.edic_text:
3175 megistanes {meg-is-tan'-es}

plural from 3176;; n m

AV - great men 2, lords 1; 3

1) the grandees, magnates, nobles, chief men
   1a) of a city or a people
   1b) of the associates or courtiers of a king
